mechanism: Dronedarone inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing risperidone plasma concentrations; both drugs prolong QT interval and increase arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor for increased risperidone adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, orthostasis); obtain baseline ECG and monitor QTc interval; consider risperidone dose reduction if dronedarone is initiated.
